summary: F2 is fixed. The scope check now runs only in a separate adapter, `halo-google-discovery-scoped`, which is used only when a custom registration supplies `googleOAuthScopes`. Built-in Google presets and refreshes keep the original `google-discovery` format without the check. A durable test covers a preset refresh, and a temp test covers fetching a document that does not declare the preset's scopes. Both test tiers pass, every changed line is covered, and no findings remain open.
